title: Turning Off-Policy Tokens On-Policy: A Plug-in Approach for Improving LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2607.04728v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models (LLMs) follows a efficient paradigm of "rollout then update", which inevitably results in off-policy training data. To resolve this, Importance sampling (IS) is proposed, while the token-level ratios compound over long sequences, causing severe variance exploded. A natural idea is "transferring" these off-policy token into on-policy token, so that the importance scores for correction are unnecessary. Following this idea, we propose Selective Importance Sampling (SIS), which is inspired by rejection sampling. Concretely, SIS implements by viewing off-policy model as proposal distribution, and implement a token-level rejection test: accepted tokens are viewed as on-policy, so that receive unit importance score, while rejected tokens retain the standard IS correction. Our proposed SIS is theoretically proved reducing the gap between token-level and sequence-level

translated_title: 将离策略令牌转化为在策略令牌：一种用于改进大语言模型对齐的插件式方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练大语言模型（LLMs）遵循“先采样再更新”的高效范式，这不可避免地导致离策略训练数据。为解决此问题，提出了重要性采样（IS），但令牌级别的比率在长序列上复合，导致严重方差爆炸。一个自然的想法是将这些离策略令牌“转换”为在策略令牌，从而无需进行修正的重要性分数。基于这一想法，我们提出了选择性重要性采样（SIS），其灵感来源于拒绝采样。具体而言，SIS通过将离策略模型视为提议分布，并实施令牌级别的拒绝测试：被接受的令牌被视为在策略令牌，从而获得单位重要性分数，而被拒绝的令牌则保留标准IS修正。理论上证明，我们提出的SIS减少了令牌级别与序列级别之间的差距。
tldr: 本文提出选择性重要性采样（SIS）方法，通过拒绝采样将离策略令牌转换为在策略令牌，减少重要性采样中的方差爆炸，并理论证明其降低了令牌级与序列级差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Selective Importance Sampling (SIS), which uses rejection sampling to convert off-policy tokens into on-policy tokens, reducing variance explosion in importance sampling and theoretically narrowing the gap between token-level and sequence-level.
